ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Register_App.Vbs LOLScript Abuse
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential abuse of the "register_app.vbs" script that is part of the Windows SDK. The script offers the capability to register new VSS/VDS Provider as a COM+ application. Attackers can use this to install malicious DLLs for persistence and execution.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "cscript\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "wscript\.exe")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.vbs\\ \\-register\\ .*"))
